notes.title: NCA VERSUS Presents Blade & Soul Heroes
notes.content:
[p]Calling all NCA Players! On [b]September 22 at 11am PDT [/b]([url="https://everytimezone.com/s/587640c8"]see your timezone here[/url]), the community managers of Aion, Lineage 2, and Blade & Soul will go head-to-head in our brand-new Twitch series, [i]NCA Versus[/i]. Each CM will fight for their community in a series of fun in-game competitions, and the winner will unlock special rewards for their players. Along the way, viewers can also snag free giveaways—so everyone has a chance to win![/p][p][/p][p]This debut stream will take place inside [b]Blade & Soul Heroes[/b], our brand-new game launching on September 24th! But beyond the battles, we’ll also share some NCA news and sneak peeks of what’s coming next for NCA. Don’t miss the chance to cheer on your CM, represent your community in the combined Twitch chat, and hear the latest news[/p][p][/p][h2][b]📺 Watch live from your community below 📺[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://twitch.tv/bnsheroes"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://twitch.tv/bladeandsoul"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://twitch.tv/aion"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://twitch.tv/lineage2us"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Blade & Soul Heroes Launch Time: 6AM PDT
notes.content: [h3][b]Launch Time Announcement[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649513/1fc4834c25235136c3b7e617a8b656dfdc70327e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Set your alarms! ⏰ Blade & Soul Heroes launches at [b]6AM PDT on September 24th, 2025![/b] Check your time zone so you can start playing the game right when servers open![/p][p]We are so excited for you all to experience the game next week! 🤩[/p][p][/p][p]Also, take a look at our latest gameplay trailer, Battle & World! Prepare for battle with diverse combat modes with your 5-hero team in this anime-inspired world called the Earthen Realm.[/p][p]If you haven’t already, make sure to Wishlist now![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="lD_zO8voIsM;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Updated Pre-Registration Rewards!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649513/08c47d66b1977a87df5c3dbe8d26b853a7470233.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Welcome Blade & Soul Heroes Community![/b] [/h3][p][/p][p]Blade & Soul Heroes has reached 2 million pre-registrations! We cannot thank you enough for all your support and interest in the game and we are so excited for you all to play.  [/p][p]As a big thank you, we are giving out special 1 million and 2 million pre-registration milestone rewards to everyone![/p][p]In addition, we have updated our pre-registration rewards to include all those who Wishlisted on Steam and pre-registered on mobile! Now everyone can enjoy the pre-registration rewards regardless of which platform they play the game on.[/p][p]We have also prepared additional exclusive rewards for those who pre-registered through the website![/p][p]We hope you are looking forward to receiving your rewards and playing Blade & Soul Heroes when it launches on September 24th![/p]
